sources.src/editors/PersonnelEditor.vue:
<template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import { getStaticConfig } from "../services/config-service.js";

export default {
  name: "PersonnelRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return getStaticConfig("personnel-form")
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) this.applyConfig(response.data);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
          this.formApi.setValue({
            parentId: this.parentNode.id,
            parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
            parentName: this.parentNode.name,
          });
        }
      });
      this.rule = rules;
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>
sources.src/editors/StructureEditor.vue:
<template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import { getStaticConfig } from "../services/config-service.js";

export default {
  name: "StructureRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return getStaticConfig("structure-form")
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) this.applyConfig(response.data);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      this.rule = this.buildRuleSet(config.rule);
      this.writeParentValues();
    },
    buildRuleSet(sourceRules) {
      const rules = sourceRules.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
        }
      });
      return rules;
    },
    writeParentValues() {
      this.formApi.setValue({
        parentId: this.parentNode.id,
        parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
        parentName: this.parentNode.name,
      });
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>

rules.body:
Apply when a shared progress source serves distinct visits and attempts, startup can emit synchronously, full-frame decoding may finish later, and history and presentation have different lifetimes. README.md: "Selecting a file creates a visit. Retry replaces the physical attempt without
opening another visit. Selecting the same file object again opens a new visit." README.md: "The source is shared by attempts and visits for that file. start may emit cached
packets synchronously; decoding yields a full frame, immediately or later.
Decode completion order can differ from packet arrival order." Confirm these premises and the target's display-order requirement before applying freshness suppression.

Register panel reception before invoking startup, preserving later streaming. Original src/workflow.go: "env.Call(\"start\",file.Token);subscription=env.Call(\"listen\",file.Token,callback)". TASK: "Restore the initial progress update without changing the public\ntransfer, retry, navigation, cleanup, audit, or queue-record behavior." Make retirement effective during startup so subsequent packets cannot start new work through an obsolete subscription, even before the outer startup returns. Keep already admitted decoding separate from that admission decision.

When the task requires full-frame freshness, assign ordering at packet reception before decoding or callback-capable work. Scope ordering to the display owner, including attempts sharing one visit. After a newer frame has been published, suppress older frames only from presentation. Recheck both visit authority and publication order after audit callbacks; commit the publication watermark before calling the display sink, which may reenter delivery. TASK: "Full\nprogress frames may decode out of order; do not allow an older frame to roll the\ncurrent display backward." README.md: "A full frame replaces displayed state; loaded values can decrease or reset." Reception order, rather than loaded magnitude or completion order, determines freshness. Buffering every result until arrival order can be reconstructed is not required.

Keep audit completion independent of display permission. Capture the originating file, attempt and visit; retain the existing audit effect for each admitted decode, including completion after hide, replacement, cancellation or disposal. Audit before deciding whether to paint, then recheck visit authority and freshness because audit may synchronously navigate or complete another decode. README.md: "recordProgress appends transfer history; showProgress paints the open panel." Original src/workflow.go: "deliver:=func(frame interface{}){;audit(frame);view(frame,order)}". A stale display frame still retains its history effect.

Coordinate ownership across callback-capable startup and cleanup. Publish cleanup ownership before startup callbacks can navigate; reconcile the returned handle without overwriting resources installed by newer navigation. Remove old resources from current ownership before canceling them, and recheck the navigation request after cleanup returns. Cancel captured retired resources and preserve repeated cleanup behavior. README.md: "One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit
more than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide
another visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the
returned cleanup handle." README.md: "Removing a listener commits removal before calling the host detach callback;
that callback may synchronously select, hide or dispose. Repeated removal is
inert. Host callbacks execute synchronously unless explicitly deferred." Preserve cancellation order from src/workflow.go: "h.CancelContext();h.Stop();h.Env.Call("cancel",h.File.Token,h.Number)". A provisional handle is an implementation option, not a required public API.

Keep an accepted retry bound to its entry visit and file across cancellation reentry. Cancel the previous attempt before enqueueing, retain the accepted command's record and attempt creation, cancel its resulting attempt if its visit has ended, and publish its queued notice only while that visit remains current. <template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import personnelConfig from "../config/personnel-form.json";

export default {
  name: "PersonnelRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return Promise.resolve()
        .then(() => this.waitForFormApi())
        .then(() => {
          this.applyConfig(personnelConfig);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    waitForFormApi() {
      const isReady = () =>
        this.formApi && typeof this.formApi.setValue === "function";
      if (isReady()) return Promise.resolve();
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const unwatch = this.$watch(isReady, (ready) => {
          if (ready) {
            unwatch();
            resolve();
          }
        });
      });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
          this.formApi.setValue({
            parentId: this.parentNode.id,
            parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
            parentName: this.parentNode.name,
          });
        }
      });
      this.rule = rules;
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>

<template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import { getStaticConfig } from "../services/config-service.js";

export default {
  name: "StructureRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return getStaticConfig("structure-form")
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) this.applyConfig(response.data);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      this.rule = this.buildRuleSet(config.rule);
      this.writeParentValues();
    },
    buildRuleSet(sourceRules) {
      const rules = sourceRules.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
        }
      });
      return rules;
    },
    writeParentValues() {
      this.formApi.setValue({
        parentId: this.parentNode.id,
        parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
        parentName: this.parentNode.name,
      });
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>
